content:
Apple yesterday released iOS 27 beta 5, which, in addition to new app icons and Spotlight design adjustments, also contains code related to all new iPhone models expected to launch in the next six to eight months.

Code for unreleased iPhones

As first discovered by Macworld, six yet-to-be-released iPhones are mentioned inside iOS 27 beta 5, covering the entire iPhone 18 lineup, the iPhone Air 2, and the upcoming foldable iPhone Ultra. The relevant code was found in system files related to the iPhone battery driver and battery intelligence features.

The code contains only Apple's internal identifiers (such as V62, V63, etc.), with no marketing names. However, based on other leaks, these model identifiers can be mapped to their expected marketing names:

  • V62: iPhone Air 2
  • V63: iPhone 18 Pro
  • V64: iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • V67: iPhone 18
  • V68: iPhone Ultra (or iPhone Fold)
  • V69: iPhone 18e

This update does not provide any further information about these devices. Apple is expected to kick off the iPhone 18 annual release cycle next month with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The iPhone Ultra is also expected to debut alongside them next month.

The iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 are reportedly scheduled to launch in early 2027. This year, Apple is adjusting the iPhone release schedule for the first time, splitting its product launches throughout the year into two windows.
